notes.title: Free Soundtrack Is Back
notes.content:
[i]Restless ones...[/i]

I was recently made aware that Steam removed their Media Player in the last UI Update replacing it with a Soundtrack Player. Nice thing about the old Media Player is it would automatically scan your installed game folders for any soundtrack albums and add them for you to play. This was how you would listen to the Spirits Abyss soundtrack that came with the game files, but unfortunately the new Soundtrack Player can't do this so there was no longer a way to play the album natively in Steam... until now!

A free Soundtrack DLC has been added to the Spirits Abyss store page which you can activate and will be added to your Soundtrack Player. Just something for those times you fancy the feel of plunging into an Abyss but can't be bothered to boot up the game to enjoy those catchy chiptunes. Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Hubby Maintenance update (v15)
notes.content:
Welcome back restless spirits. :]

Today's update is a very general maintenance update modernising some various QoL stuff.

The biggest change is there's now a cosy little Hub that you enter from the title screen, so instead of faffing around through the various menus you can just hop about to your intended game mode or options. There's some extra bits and bobs in there too, like a dedicated Achievement pedestal for easier tracking of progress and as an extra challenge there's now gems displayed around the monument where you choose your Clan which change colour based on feats within the game modes for each Clan.

The game's base resolution of 256x144 has been slightly increased to 274x154. I felt previously the game was just a little bit too zoomed in so you now have a bit of extra screen estate to spot hazards (especially below you). It also scales much more nicely to 1080p so there's very little pixel weirdness at that resolution now.

The basic pixel font has been upgraded to be more readable, and there's now a double resolution version which is On by default. You can switch back to the pixel pure font by changing the Font Type in the settings.

The Abysm Challenges game mode has been spiced up too. The Wonky Weekender has been replaced with the Fortnightly Challenge which uses the Undying Pilgrimage so now there's a challenge for each game mode with a new seed being set every 2 weeks. Both the Weekly and Fortnightly challenges can also be played as many times as you like now too (you still only get one shot at the Daily though!)

When playing Co-Op mode if the ghostly Co-Op player is hurt then he now just instantly teleports back to the main player (instead of him having to touch your body to revive you which could be a bit of faffing). If the main player's input is set to Keyboard then the game will now also auto-detect the Co-Op player's input and set it to a connected pad (previously it would default to an Xbox pad even if only a Playstation pad was plugged in).

Some improvements to Settings...
- General - Resolution: Two new high resolutions have been added as options (2560x1440 and 3840x2160).
- General - Display: A new Borderless Window option has been added.
- Audio: A new Master Volume setting has been added.

Other misc stuff...
- The game has been updated to the latest version of GameMaker (v2023.8) which might help with compatibility.
- The game's window caption no longer has the version number (since some programs were resetting their properties due to the caption changing each patch).
- All menus now have button tips which show what the Menu Confirm and Back buttons are.
- The Exit menu now has an option to do a Quick Restart of that game mode or quit straight to the title screen (nice for Blood Moon Trials).
- The sound effect volume for picking up all Gems has been reduced (they were a bit shrill).
- The sound effect volume for running and jumping has been slightly reduced (could get a bit annoying).
- The Pro-HUD colours for the stage time/score are now both a dark blue colour (so they are less confused with the total time/score).
- When playing a new stage tune it can no longer choose the same tune that was just playing.
- Stage 2 of a Restless Adventure and Undying Pilgrimage will now always have a Shop.
- The stage entrance and exit room in the Perditions Path region has been spruced up.
- Shop special room: If the Shopkeeper becomes angry because you destroyed a Shop wall then he now has a different speech (so it's clearer what happened).
- Vampire Coffin special room: His items will now behave like a shop item (eg standing in front of it will show its description and you take it by pressing up instead of jumping into it).
- Hat Unlock Vault special room: This now has slightly less walls and you may not even need a bomb to reach the chest (so you're wasting less resources on a nice unlock).
- Chest Vault special room: There's now a 50% chance the chest will now also contain an item, however in which case it will be guarded by a Mercenary.
- Sealed Domain - The Sullenwoods: Offering Hearts to the tree will now be saved between runs (so they're not wasted).
- The Frostal Fields and Sullenwoods regions will now use the special entrance rooms in stage 1 of a Restless Adventures and Undying Pilgrimage (previously only the Haunt Burials used it).
- Paupers clan: He will no longer be offered the Orbital Conjurors clan relic (as it's useless).
- Lexicanium Hunt game mode: The Tome in the final stage now can't spawn in a room close to a level edge (makes speed running it a bit less rng).
- Clashful Cares: Each player's Beating Heart card now starts with 69 Health instead of 50 (games can be a bit quick if you focus exclusively on the Heart).

Bug fixes...
- If the Teleport Curse triggered in a small room then it could cause a hard lock (eg in the Lexicanium Hunt boss room).
- Using the Card Devourer item when stood in front of a mirror would cause a crash.
- Using the Chaotica Bell when there's a Cursed Vault in the mapp would cause a crash.
- When ending a game of Clashful Cards there was a rare chance of causing a crash.
- If you got 2+ achievements on the same frame then the Achievement Manager would only update the first achievement gotten.
- Restless Adventure - End Boss: After killing the Boss if you got hurt and fell into the hole then it would cause a soft-lock.
- Lexicanium Hunt - End Boss: If you died to a particular attack then the death message would show the Gravetender's message instead of the Overseer's.
- Zombie enemy: If the Co-Op player was hit by his bite attack then both players would be hurt.
- Wally Vomiter enemy: He would never drop his Clashful Card.
- Curse Bearer / Cursedom Lordus enemy: Part of their sprites was unintentionally using an off-black colour.
- Card Match special room: If both the Item and Consumable were of the same item then it wouldn't count as a match.
- Gaming Store sub-stage: Buying a Clashful Card from the seller wasn't permanently unlocking the Card.
- Shroom Shack sub-stage: You could jump off the left-side of the map by going up from where you spawned.
- Cargo Carriages sub-stage: The Guard wasn't waking up if you took the item from a Skelly Statue room.
- Selestious Halo item: If you were revived by this item then it would stop the current map timer.


Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Patch v14.20

Some bug fixes and other bits and bobs tweaks based on feedback. :]


[b]// General Stuff[/b]
- Updated the game's engine to the latest version of GameMaker so the issue some were having with fullscreen slow down should be fixed and apparently there should be slightly better performance too.
- In Single Player the game will now auto-update the active gamepad when a button is pressed (previously you had to manually set it).

- The game now defaults to fullscreen (to conform with Steam Deck requirements).
- Added an Auto Ledge Grab setting in the player options, which when on will auto-grab nearby ledges when falling (ala Spelunky).
- Abysm Challenges: The Wonky Weekend has been renamed to Wonky Weeker and can now be replayed as many times as you like. If you died with zero score then you can replay the challenge. If you haven't yet beaten a Lexicanium Hunt then the Weekly Roam and Wonky Weeker wont be playable.

- If you have a lot of cursed hearts when fighting a boss then getting hurt will randomly use up more than one cursed heart.

notes.title: Accursed Nightmares (v14)
notes.content:
[i]Greetings again restless cherubs. It would seem your Father has thrown you into the Abyss once more... but you are not alone, for a hundred hungerous lidless eyes see you![/i]

A few days ago marked a year since the release of Spirits Abyss. After a very manic Early Access it was nice to take a break from the Abyss and come back to it with fresh eyes. But firstly a big thanks to YOU for the really great reception to the game. :]

This update focusses on the main three game modes: Hunt, Adventure, and Pilgrimage, and in particular adding new late game content. But there's some other bits and bobs to play with too.


[h2]New Regions[/h2]
Two new unlockable regions have been added called the Cursedom Temple and Endless Nightmare which can only be unlocked in the Undying Pilgrimage game mode. They are pretty chaotic and difficult so once unlocked they become new optional regions that you can choose to enter or not, if you dare.

The Cursedom Temple is a mad place suffused with curses and adds 5 new enemies. A new variant of the Restless Realms has also been added, called the Accursed Realms. Again the Accursed Realms are an optional area which can be accessed in two special ways if you fancy an extra challenge.

The Endless Nightmare is a truly peculiar place. It doesn't have any new enemies, instead the entire level, it's layout, traps, and enemies, are randomly plucked from every other region of the game.


[h2]New Clans[/h2]
Two new clans have been added called the Monastic and Technocrats, which can only unlocked in the new regions. The Monastic are a cursed order but can mutate their bombs into controllable pets, while the Technocrat make use of technology and their own mecha-constructs. They're intended for experienced players so are rather unusual with their abilities.


[h2]Guardian Sentinels[/h2]
Something I wanted with this update was to make the three main game modes feel a bit more unique from one another. In the Adventure mode before entering the Fallen Sanctum you'll now be confronted by a new mini-boss to contend with, the Sanctum Sentinel (though there is a secret way to bypass it). Since thematically they defend the Sanctum from intruders, in the Hunt mode the Fallen Sanctum has been replaced with the Sanctum Outerwall. And in the Pilgrimage a new Restless Sentinel awaits who defends the vortex to the Restless Realms.


[h2]Special Hearts[/h2]
Two new special heart types have been added, Restless Hearts and Cursed Hearts, which behave like the Pure Hearts. Restless Hearts however offer less invincibility and are automatically removed at stage end. Cursed Hearts offer random invincibility and the chance of inflicting a curse effect. Speaking of which, 9 new curse effects have been added, ranging from turning everybody on screen into exploding frogs or bat bombs, to simply dropping a massive lit bomb on your bonce.


[h2]Other New Stuff[/h2]
- Added 13 achievements related to the new content.
- 4 new sub-stages: Gamester Boutique, Cargo Carriages, Views Apparition, Olden Trial. Of note is the Boutique, which offers a way to make use of your collected Clashful Cards within the normal game modes.
- 6 new level special rooms, ranging from cursed monuments, to a desperate feller being hunted by a wraith.
- 16 new items, ranging from mecha-constructs, a holy item capable of rebirth, to a device that teleports all crates to you.
- Added a Quick Look button for speedily looking down.
- Added a Clan Skins setting, which allows you to set skins independently for each Clan.


[h2]Region Changes[/h2]
[b]Slimes Mire[/b]
- The variants look a bit different now. Previously just some of the walls would be recoloured but now all of them are.
- Added a pink variant that's very shroomy and bouncy and contains a big mushroom chest.
- Added the chance for a boingy exit which can extend straight up.

[b]Sinners Chambers[/b]
- Added the chance for a normal non-path room to have a vertical wall to block off the row (level was otherwise a bit too open).
- Added some decorative dudes to the jails to keep you company.

[b]The Sullenwoods[/b]
- Hanged Haunts have a chance of dropping a Restless Heart upon death.

[b]Restless Realms[/b]
- Soulmass and Soulstorms have a chance of dropping a Restless Heart upon death (or Cursed Heart in the case of the Accursed Realm).


[h2]Other Random Changes[/h2]
- The Minesmithers clan can now mine upwards by holding... Up!
- On the Game Mode selection screen pressing Down will now take you straight to that game mode's online leaderboard.
- Added a new track specific to the Nightmare region (called Shipwreck In The Pacific Ocean).
- Added some new level entry art when starting an Adventure or Pilgrimage in the normal regions.
- All huge chests now require a bomb to open (or Skeleton Key).
- If a booby trapped cursed crate is attacked there's now a chance it will turn into a Cursed Frog.
- Replaced all the Black & White screen effects with a slightly less eye scorching pink effect.

[b]Sub-Stages[/b]
- Sealed Domain (Ashen Palace): Float blocks will always appear here now (so more items are useful).
- Sealed Domain (Sanguine Mechanius): A Chaotica Jewel will now also open it.
- Sealed Domain (Frostal Fields): Added a bunch of different items that will be used when interacting with the door to open it.
- Fairy Fountain: Bestowing a cursed item will now always result in you being cursed.

[b]Stage Special Rooms[/b]
- Shop: If you buy all four items in a noble shop you'll now be given a Loyalty Card.
- Sin Repent: There's now a chance of the creature being Accursed, in which case the heart offering will be turned into a cursed heart instead of pure.
- Cursed Vault: Regular Jewels and Cracked Jewels can now also open it with a slightly different effect.

[b]Item Changes[/b]
- Snow Globe: This item's use has been changed. It now acts like a souped-up Glint Firecrackers, plus any walls onscreen will be replaced with ice blocks and the region will switch to a cold variant if available.
- Spookobomb: You're no longer immortal when using this item (sorry).
- Mommy's Bow: This now gives a Restless Heart instead of a normal one.
- Divine Trinket: Removed the Pure Heart aspect as it was a bit confusing.
- Crate Locator: Renamed to Loot Locator as it now also shows treasure chests on your map.


[h2]Other Game Mode Stuff[/h2]
The other game modes haven't been completely left out.

[b]Cabin Reminiscel[/b]
- Added a new fishy NPC to the hub.
- The game mode unlock mirror will now only show after the Undying Pilgrimage has been beaten.
- Other unlocks will now show in this game mode (eg Hat/Clan unlocks).

[b]Clashful Cards[/b]
- 7 new Fighter Cards have been added.

[b]Blood Moon Trials[/b]
- Added 3 new trials: Preserver Purity Trial, Nightmare Realm Trial, Telemond Time Trial.

[b]Soul Survival[/b]
- The Gleam Monocle will now also hide all falling snow.
- Added 8 items to the stage item pool.


[h3]*PHEW*[/h3]


That's your lot for now. Enjoy, and here's some screenies to wet your accursed appetites! :]

notes.title: Patch v13.17
notes.content:
Mostly just a big bunch of bug fixes, but a few niceties too. Content update coming later in the year. :]

- Improved the overall level performance, notably in the Haunt Burials and Slimes Mire (these two regions had the lowest performance).
- Death Sequence: Changed the stark white in the intial black & white effect to a less eyeball melting pink.
- Settings - Mouse Controls: This option will now also count the left/right mouse buttons to be used as Menu Confirm/Back with the Button Icons updating accordingly. It also clamps the mouse to the game window when the gameplay is active (ie not when the Status Screen is up).
- Setting the Menu Confirm/Back button the same as the Item button will no longer cause conflicts (eg on the Status Screen).
- Settings - Rebind Gamepad buttons: When setting the Menu Confirm/Back button it wasn't detecting if the button was already in use (and therefore possible to set both to the same button). The Confirm/Back prompt wasn't correctly showing.
- Settings - Control Input Config: The co-op play input wasn't saving correctly if the inputs were being swapped between the players.
- Settings - Button Icons: When currently selected it now shows the Menu Confirm/Back button prompts so you can see their effect.
- Playstation 4 Gamepad: The Share button should now correctly show ingame.
- Abysm Challenges: The three game mode menu gems weren't appearing (it now shows a gem for each current challenge you have submitted a score to).
- Loading the Abysm Challenges menu was wrongly changing the currently selected Clan causing issues with some menus (eg it would set the default Leaderboard to that Clan).
- Co-op: if Player 1 was stood in front of an examinable object and Player 2 pressed Up then Player 1 would wrongly examine the object. The examine button prompt would wrongly change to Player's 2 input if he was the last player to press a button.
- Grimoire Compendium - The Blood Moon Trials clan sweeps stat wasn't being set correctly. Fixed a few Beastiary visual bugs.
- Cabin Reminiscel - The crypt key now spawns in Stage 1 (so it shows in the Hunt mode). Killing a boss carrying the Collection Bowl would give a wrong amount of gold from the falling gem.
- Stage Complete: When choosing a gift the item bubbles that don't contain Clan items now have a different sprite.
- Sealed Domain unlock doorway - Ashen Palace: Restless Staff projectiles were wrongly not destroying the skulls. Runic Hammers were wrongly being destroyed by the skull's shield. Examining the doorway whilst carrying the Enrealmed Cloak or Polymorph Potion will now also work. Added an extra line of text when examining the door hinting at the skulls.
- Sealed Domain unlock doorway - Frostal Fields: The Gilded Hammer can now also be used to unlock the region.
- Slimes Mire: Breaking pots now have a chance of spawning a Gnatty instead of a Buzzy (chance is based on the Stage number). There was a chance one of the normal terrain rooms would create a Crate/Chest inside a wall (which would hide it). The exit room had a chance of cutting off one of its side paths (thus could block off a shop entrance).
- Rollerrone: Fixed an issue where after it was hit it would sometimes spin in mid-air when making contact with a wall (especially if you destroyed the wall it was tunnelling into).
- Buzzy/Gnatty/Bloaty Blighter: Fixed some visual issues related to their variants (eg Cursed/Hot variants not showing correct colours for particles/deaths).
- Sleeping Gravetenders/Mercenaries will now be rudely awakened if hit by a miscellaneous attack (such as a falling icicle).
- Booby trapped chest bomb explosions will now fire off a few mini-explosions (just like all other cursed bombs).
- Bombs/Bomb Box: When picked up they weren't showing the usual number effect so you know how many you picked up.
- Wraithen Talon: Some enemies weren't giving flams when you killed them.
- Bernard's Watch: The slow-down effect seems to break the frame rate for some people so it's been changed (for a short time it now makes you super fast, can jump high, and gives some invincibility).
- Gilded Hammer: Using the Hammer wasn't affecting its durability correctly.
- Succulent Apple/Bomb Dust/Mommy's Bow: These will now confer their bonus health/bombs at stage start alongside a sound and visual effect so you can see exactly what they gave.
- Puzzle Box: This will now correctly give you a gift at the beginning of Death's Tithe.
- Perfumed Playdough: Changed it's description to be more clearer what it does.
- Soulic Jewel: If were already carrying one and picked up another then it wasn't creating the second Jewel that swirls around you until the next stage.
- Coffined Vampire: Made his secrets more obvious.
- Abyssaletto: You can now bomb the machine if you really hate gambling. If you were carrying a Soulic Jewel when playing the machine then the jewel would wrongly show over the screen.
- Cursed Bomb Regurgeifier: It's backwall sprite was always blue instead of correctly using the region's colour.
- Skelly Statue: Stealing his item wasn't creating the usual item tip popup.
- Pacifist Realm Trial: You now need the Frostal Fields region unlocked to open this trial. The Sullenwoods and Blaspheme Librarium wrongly had a chance of showing up.
- Warlocks unlock: After freeing him he would wrongly be wearing your hat in the scene outside.
- Game Intro: Fixed a typo.

notes.title: Sullen Satiation (v13)
notes.content:
[i]Back again I see, for a final glimpse as the Abysm gapes its last breath...[/i]

Hey cherubs. This is the final Early Access content update before Spirits Abyss unseals its shackles and will release from Early Access next Thursday (Aug 27th). I'll still be doing some tinkering until the release so if you have any bug reports, feedback, etc, then let me know in the forums. :]

A new unlockable region has been added called The Sullenwoods. There hanged haunts and flesh ghouls roam the barrows. It's quite easy to unlock as it's intended as more of an introduction into how the region unlock system works. There's also a new achievement for unlocking it.

The 2 player Co-Op health system has been changed. Now the twin is basically immortal so won't take off health from the main player, but if he's hurt then he crumbles into a bone pile and must be revived by the main player by simply moving into him.

There's some new meanies to contend with...
- 5 new elite enemies have been added who are rather a bit more dangerous than the regular enemies. The chance of them showing up is based on the game mode to make each mode feel a bit more different. For example, in the Pilgrimage they'll always show up in addition to the regular enemies, but in an Adventure have a low chance of appearing instead of a regular enemy. They won't show at all in a Hunt.
- The Ashen Palace has an easier variant which has a chance of showing if you're still early in the run. A new enemy called the Necarch will have made its home their instead of the Wraiths. There's also a new enemy called the Ash Husk who will appear in the stage irrespective of the variant. A variant of the Necarch also has a chance of appearing in the Spooker's Reckoning instead of the usual gang of spooks as an extra challenge late on.
- 2 new enemies have also been added, one in the Sanguine Mechanius (Blood Boil) and one in the Death's Tithe (Coin Watcher) just to add a bit more variety.

10 new special rooms have been added, intended to just add some more variety in the stages. Ranging from teleporters, water wells, the Abysmletto slots machine and return of the poor banged up Pauper pincher.

6 new items have been added to round out the total amount of items to 80: Skeleton Key, Crate Locator, Skull Familiar, Drill Fister, Snow Globe, Restless Staff.

Some Clashful Cards tinkering...
- Your current Win Streak is now saved. A menu has been added after the clash has ended so you can change game mode without forfeiting your streak.
- 6 new themes (4 affect gameplay).
- New Lightning Spell that inflicts 1-6 damage on an enemy.
- New Transmutations action that changes all your current action cards into random actions.
- 13 new fighter cards associated to the new enemies.

Some Blood Moon Trials changes...
- 9 new trials added including no-hurty Undying boss trials.
- The Grimoire Compendium now has stats for this game mode.
- The choose trial menu icons will now be a different colour if a trial is complete but not by the current Clan.

Some Soul Survivor changes...
- Added 6 new meanies into the enemy pool.
- Added 4 new items into the item pool.

Some Cabins Reminiscel changes...
- Compendium: Replaced the Realmic Nodes stat with Special Secrets which includes all the Cabin mode hub unlockables.
- After playing your first Mirrored Abysm a sign appears outside the mirror cave entrance that shows the Cabin mode stats.
- Forest Shop: You now can't buy duplicate gear.

And some various other stuff...
- Settings: Added a "Right Stick Attack" control option in which case the gamepad's right analogue stick is used for both aiming and attacking.
- Settings - CRT Screen: Added a "light" option which reduces the screen distortion in particular (to reduce motion sickness).
- Added a small deadzone to the gamepad analogue sticks to help prevent stick drift.
- The game will auto-pause if the gamepad is disconnected or loses power and gameplay was happening.
- Added Cursed Chests: They have an extra chance of being booby trapped or containing curse coloured items.
- Hushed Monastery: Giving the fatso enough bombs makes his tummy go boomy.
- Seraphus Feather: You can now carry up to 3, each conferring an extra air-jump.
- Soulic Jewel: There's now a chance it may not crack if you were hurt by a low damage hit. They now auto-sell if carried to a boss.
- Puzzle Box: There's now a small chance the Box won't have an item that stage (the chance is increased a bit based on how many items you've had from it). If you already have a fair amount of bombs then the Box will have a very low chance of giving you any bombs.
- Cutty Cutlery: The chance of you gaining extra hearts/bombs is now also based on how many you already have (e.g. having a lot of bombs reduces the chance of getting more).
- Confession Kapala/Collection Bowl: Slightly decreased how often you receive hearts.
- Flesh Warden: They now have a magic attack if they can see you but can't reach you with their regular club attack.
- Gnatty: Added Cursed and Hot variants.
- Bounty Hunters now have a chance of being sleepy.
- Regionals Juncture: There's now a chance of a doorway being blocked (a handy bomb will do the trick). The chosen region is now independent of the normal way regions are chosen code-wise (so it's now possible to visit the same alternate region more than once).
- Some regions have an increased chance of having certain special rooms that suite their theme (e.g. Sanguine Mechanius has a good chance of having machine related special rooms).
- Special room - Wizard Trick: Offering a curse coloured item makes him auto-fail his spell.
- Special room - Cursed Vault: The chest now also contains a curse coloured item.
- Special room - Item Refiner: Refining a cursed coloured item will make it auto-explode with an even bigger boom. Added a cap of 10k gold, after which it auto-explodes.
- Special room - Chests Gamble: Added a star prize (a Soulic Jewel) and slightly increased chance of winning.
- Fate's Hallway: Added some walled-off chest rooms and spruced up the background.
- Crossings Shrine: Added a couple of chests at the top.
- Angry shopkeepers and mercenaries will now suffer damage from hazards (e.g. big saw blades).
- The big falling icicles (usually found in Frostal Fields) can now hurt enemies.
- Quite a bunch of bug fixes and other minor bits and bobs.

Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Varianment Monastery (v12)
notes.content:
Greetings cherubs. :]

With this update the main focus has been adding more variety to runs and to add new ways of using up your resources, such as new rooms and items where you can use hearts/bombs in weird ways. I've had some great feedback on the very early game too so there's some changes to make getting into the early game more smooth. There's also some finishing up of the Cabins Reminiscel game mode.

A Beastiary has been added to the Grimoire Compendium. It keeps track of the beasties and bosses you've killed and gives some new info about them, like their names and a bit of lore. Two new achievements have been added for filling it up.

There's been some inventory improvements. There's now Next/Previous Gear buttons so you can switch equipable gear during play instead of having to open up the Status Screen. Speaking of which the Status Screen now has a Sort button which moves all usables to top of your inventory, and I manged to squeeze in an extra 3 item slots per page.

Four variant stage themes have been added, which changes the look of the level as well as the behaviour of some enemies, the obstacles you face, and the level generation. The Haunt Burials has a new cursed and chilly variants, the Slimes Mire a hot variant, and the Fallen Sanctum a chilly variant.

A new sub-stage has been added called the Hushed Monastery. There you'll find a cheery big fella and a husk of a little guy where you can offer some of your excess health and bombs for random niceness.

A Wanted system has been added for if you're rude enough to kill the kindly shopkeepers. Killing them increases your Wanted level, which will slowly go down at the end of each stage. If you're Wanted then shopkeepers shoot you on site and Mercenaries will roam the stage depending on how wanted you are. The Spooker's Reckoning will also be replaced with a Guilder's Reckoning.

8 new special rooms have been added to the regular stages. Ranging from you helping a vampyre out, getting polymorphed by a wizard or repenting your sins... just don't get swallowed by huge head!

18 New items have been added: Cotton Candy, Chip Cookie, Queen of Hearts, King of Spades, Displacer Field, Chaotica Bell, Sinners Trinket, Midas Touch, Gift Treat, Perfumed Playdough, Collection Bowl, Gilded Hammer, Mommy's Bow, Auton Repairer, Polymorpth Potion, Fishing Rod, Blood Monkey, Piggy Bank.

Some Cabins Reminiscel upgrades...
- On the Mirror Device you can now choose the game mode to play (Hunt, Adventure, Pilgrimage) assuming you have completed those modes the normal way, and you can now choose the exact Stage to start on.
- Added scenes for when you defeat the game mode bosses.
- Added a scene for when you return from the Abyss.
- Spawn rate of Ensouled Artefacts is much more generous now. Previously once you had a fair amount they became very difficult to find, but now each stage has a very high chance of having an Ensouled Chest and they may contain up to 3 Artefacts.
- Added a room to naturally end the Sullenwoods.

Some balance changes to make the very early game easier to get into...
//Haunt Burials
- Zombie: They now do a bite attack if they run directly into you, otherwise just bumping into them now only does 1 damage.
- Batty: Increased their hit mask so they're easier to kill (the mask they use to hit you remains the same).
- Big graves: They now have a chance of spawning the more easily to deal with baby ghosts instead of the flying skull ghosts (the chance is dependent on the stage).
//Slimes Mire
- Buzzy: Their damage has been reduced to 1 when idle and 2 when alert. Increased their hit mask so they're easier to kill, and their attack mask has been reduced so it's harder for them to hit you.
- Gnatty: Their damage has been reduced to 0.5
- The various Blob projectiles have been recoloured pink so they're easier to see and makes it clear they are to be avoided.

Other bits and bobs...
- The game over screen now has a specific message based on what killed you.
- 4 new Clashful Cards fighters (Guild Merchant, Mercenary, Jumbo Hailstone, Chaos Shade).
- Cursed chests and cursed gems have been added.
- Added bouncy boingas to the Slimes Mire for a bit of a laugh.
- Settings - Aim Indicator: Added a Smart option which will only display the arrows if you're a melee Clan and aren't aiming directly forward.
- Tidied up the Control Settings menus.
- Crates: Slightly reduced their chance of bombs, particularly if you have a fair amount of them already.
- Tithe Collector: If his attacks hurt you then you'll release coins.
- Goopy Bombs: These will now stick to enemies and bosses.
- Gleam Monocle: Each stage now has at least 1 pink diamond which is worth more than a regular diamond. However, pink diamonds can only be seen in walls if you have a Monocle.
- Safety Pin: Manually using it now creates a hurt animation but won't hurt you and doesn't cost durability.
- Confession Kapala: Reduced rate you gain hearts.
- Puzzle Box: After opening it you'll start with invincibility frames if an enemy is very close.
- Crow Caltrops: These will no longer be destroyed when an enemy touches them.
- If an enemy is hit by a player orbital (such as the flamey skulls from a Wraithen Talon) their Invincibility frames are reduced (so it affects melee Clans less).
- Fallen Sanctum: The floating vault now requires a bomb to crack open.
- Shop: Added the chance of a Gear shop, which stocks usuable items (with a good chance of non-consumables).
- Chronos Chest: You can now put in gear that doesn't have full durability.
- Blocked Hole: The boulder now has extra health based on the stage (so may require extra bombs to destroy). It now also takes into account the damage of the bomb (so you'll need more small bombs over large bombs).
- Haunt Burials: Graves haunted with Babby Ghosts will now become unhaunted if you destroy the floor beneath it.
- Fairy Fountain: Added a special response if you offer back an item you were just given by the Fairy Queen.
- Guilder's Emporium: Destroying the wall around the stage exit now makes the shoppies quite mad.
- Sealed Domain - Ash: Added a chance of floating blocks being there (so you might not need extra mobility).
- Undying Pilgrimage - Added an extra shop in a random mid-stage that's always a high quality Gear shop.
- Undying Pilgrimage - Spirits Abyss: Added the chance the stage will have chests.
- Various bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993454/53432250a7cf49674968d18b6f31efe12ba18952.png[/img]

Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Devourerous Pilgrimage (v11)
notes.content:
Greetings hungerous ones...

A new game mode has been added called the Undying Pilgrimage, intended as an extra challenge beyond the Restless Adventures. It's longer than an Adventure, contains a new multi-form end boss, two new end regions, and you'll also have to battle through variants of the existing bosses (they're a bit weaker but have a couple of new tricks up their gob). To unlock the new game mode you have to open the four Sealed Domains (or just input the Konami code on the title screen).

Plus misc changes...
- 3 new Clashful Cards fighters (Tithe Collector, Soulmass, Soulstorm).
- If you haven't unsealed the Mechanius region then during an Adventure a Skulliseller will now appear on stage 5 or 6 selling a Soulic/Cracked Jewel for a hefty price.
- Restless Purity Trial: He no longer has a second phase.
- Shroom Shack: Added chance for the chests to have other stuff. Eating a mushroom will make the big shroom quite mad.
- Purity Pendant: This item now only works if you don't currently have any pure hearts, but can now be triggered by any heart boosts (e.g. from a Kapala).
- Glass Bell: Will now do random damage against wraithen creatures (enemies from the Fallen Sanctum and Ashen Palace).
- Bottled Fairy: Will now heal more if you're low on health.
- Confession Kapala: The regen rate has been slightly reduced.
- Soulic/Cracked Jewel: If you win the game carrying one then its value is added to your score.
- Skeleton: They will now suffer damage if they fall onto spikes.
- Bubble Blobs: Gnatty's can now get stuck in them. Using a Jetpack or Feather now makes it much easier to escape from them.

And bug fixes...
- Regions 3/4 were wrongly choosing music from the 1/2 region music pool instead of their own.
- Crate items spawning in an enclosed space would sometimes spawn down through the floor.
- Eating a mushroom/choccy/pizza whilst carrying the Greasy Wrench would allow you to eat that item twice.
- Goopy Bombs: If you're against a wall and hold up when releasing the bomb it was warping downwards.
- A skeleton emerging from a pot that had a wall above would get stuck inside it.
- Regionals Juncture: There was no text for the Sinners Chambers doorway.
- Clashful Cards: Grapple attack was sometimes moving the target card to the wrong table spot.
- Compendium - Leaderboards: Setting it to the Speedrun category and then entering the Soul Survivor leaderboard would cause a crash.
- Skin Selector: Picking up a new hat unlock then exiting the game will retain the new hat despite it not being selected in the menu.

Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Paupers Sinners (v10)
notes.content:
Greetings restless sinners.. the chambers await thee.

Steam Trading Cards have been added (cheers Saint Gaben!) If you've played the game before then a bunch of cards may drop when you open the game.

A new Clan has been added called the Paupers. They are a naughty mob of thieves and vagabonds who don't have Clan Relics of their own, instead they can use Relics from every other Clan (assuming you have those Clans unlocked). They can also steal from shoppies but start with a weakling knife so you'll need cunning to stay alive to pilfer the Abyss. Like the other Clans the Paupers have to be unlocked, and now the Shinobi Clan does too.

A new region has been added called the Sinner Chambers. Home to zombiefied beasties of mangled flesh and bone, just don't get nabbed or you'll be spending your miserable days couped up in the jails. The new region can be unlocked in a similar way to the other alternate regions, a rusty gate blocks the way within.

There's been a fair few upgrades to the Clashful Cards game mode...
- Added 6 board themes which have an affect on the game (e.g. in the Slimes Mire theme you'll have to contend with exploding mushrooms).
- 5 New Actions (Critical Strike, Sucker Punch, Shiv, Grapple, Move) +plus Cursed variants of the normal attack actions.
- 5 New Spells (Doom, Strengthen, Weaken, Teleport, Slow Time).
- 3 new Clashful Cards fighters (Flesh Warden, Flesh Gobber, Flesh Birther).
- Added the current Win Streak / Best Streak to the bottom left of the screen.
- Added number risers after appropriate actions (e.g. it shows how much damage an attack did which is useful for cursed attacks).
- Spear: Will now pierce through all cards (including friendlies) and can be used if the first target is a friendly.
- Spells are now cumulative (so you can cast the same spell on the same enemy).
- Fighter decks no longer have duplicate fighters.
- The computer will now always get the first turn.
- Player Hearts now start at 50 Health and some fighter cards have had their Health/Attacks tweaked.
- Improved the turn auto-end when you have no viable actions left (previously having a spell action would never auto-end the turn).

Some new items to play with, each of the Clans getting a new relic...
- Alchemistro - Necrosis Incant: Increases your basic shot damage.
- Katanachi - Accursed Bombs: Your bombs create extra mini-explosions in random directions.
- Shinobi - Beguile Dummy: Allows you to create a dummy hero fooling enemies into attacking that instead of you.
- Minesmithers - Runic Reverb: When digging it will also destroy nearby walls that contain gems.
- Bonehaunted - Sentinel Bile: Your orbital flame protectors will do double their usual damage.
- Warlocks - Charge Shard: Hold Shoot then press Bomb to fire multiple bombs at the cost of 2 bombs.
- Safety Pin: If equipped then getting hurt will cause only 1 HP loss.
- Soul Casket: Opening it gives you numerous orbital flame protectors.

Other bits and bobs...
- 8 new achievements associated with the region/Shinobi/Paupers unlocks. Plus achievements for completing a Hunt/Adventure without picking up any gold.
- Added an Aim button for keyboards which when pressed brings up a crosshair and allows you to aim without moving.
- Added a new level sub-room (Chronos Chest) that allows you to store a few items between runs, though there are limitations.
- Added a new level sub-room (Refiner) where you can destroy an item for gems (more than you usually get for selling) but if you refine too many items the whole thing blows up hugely (leg it!)
- Added a new level sub-room (Storehouse) that just has a bunch of crates big and small that may or may not have a variety of stuff.
- Restless Adventures: Added a second phase to the End Boss when he reaches less than 50% Health.
- Lexicanium Hunt: The End Boss now has a bit more health. Also during his second phase a new attack type has been added, one of the other attack types is now not as easy to avoid, and he now attacks more frequently.
- The game will now detect any keyboard/gamepad input presses and set the appropriate menu button icons (keyboard/xbox/playstation).
- Fairy Fountain: Added a hard cap to the amount of times you can be successful when offering a diamond. When bestowing an item if it would confer a special response then it will always be successful (instead of a chance of it being ignored like any other item). Bestowing an Unholy Pact item will now confer a special response.
- Exotic Mushroom: Their invincibilty time is now halved if used during a boss fight.
- Skeleton: Reduced their Spooky Bonepile drop rate and they no longer drop them in the Soul Survivor game mode.
- Cabins Reminiscel: When entering a seed into the Mirror Device it will also display the seed used the last time you entered the Mirrored Abyss.
- On the Game Over grave scene the "exit to title screen" option has been changed to "change game mode" which takes you directly to the game mode menu on the Title Screen.
- Katanachi: Added a tip for beginners when releasing a bomb explaining that holding Down will drop it at your smelly feet.
- Removed the gems from the Fortuity Destiny clan selection as it was just causing confusion.

And some bug fixes...
- Fixed a bug with the melee Clans where sometimes you could be swinging one way but facing the other way.
- Katanachi - Goopy Bombs: If stood next to a wall the bomb wasn't immediately sticking to it if you also had other bomb relics.
- Katanachi: Bomb colours weren't being properly assigned if you had multiple relics that each affect the bomb colours (particularly Remote Bombs).
- Enrealmed Cloak: Some enemies (e.g. Boo Knight) could still see you even when enrealmed.
- Jewel / Cracked Jewel: You were getting double its value if sold from the Status Screen when inside a shop.
- Co-Op: When interacting with some level sub-room menus (e.g. Tarot Reader) opening then closing the Escape menu would re-activate the co-op player.
- Co-Op: If both players were standing in front of separate item stalls then attempting to buy an item would do weird things.
- Blood Moon Trials: During a Realm trial there was a chance the Abominable Frost enemy may cause a crash when first entering the stage.
- Compendium: The Game Mode Stats pages were showing unlocked Clans (they should have a padlock icon).

[b]Enjoy! :][/b]

notes.title: Warlocked Palace (v9)
notes.content:
Greetings restless cherubs....

A new witchy Clan has been added called the Warlocks. They start off a little weak but have powerful staff relics so you'll be pumping out a lot of magical loads sharpish. The new Clan has to be unlocked from within the Lexicaium Hunt or Restless Adventures game mode (hint: he's trapped in a snowy big friend).

A new region has also been added called the Ashen Palace. The Wraithen inhabitants won't take kindly to your presence who use magical attacks and whopping weapons to enslave your soul. Oh and watch out for haunted floating pots and spooky paintings too!

All of the alternative regions now must be unlocked to show up in runs. There's a good chance of you stumbling upon the Sealed Domain room before a stage where you'll need to figure out what items can be used to unseal the region doorway.

And more...

[b]// New Stuff[/b]
- The Minesmithers Clan must now be unlocked  (hint: the bouldered way prevents his escape).
- 8 new achievements related to the new Clan/regions/Minesmithers unlocks.
- Added a chance of you dropping into a special sub-stage called the Regionals Juncture. Assuming you have enough regions unlocked it gives you the choice of heading into one of two alternate stage regions (or you can ignore it and go to the regular region).
- Added a new special room (The Bodger): There sits a big friendly faceless fella who will buy/sell/repair equipables items. Though he's not the best at repairing items and his stock isn't in top notch condition.
- 2 new Clashful Cards fighters (Wraith, Wraithen King).
- Blaspheme Librarium: Added Warpstones to each row which allow you to teleport between them (since Clans with a reduced jump height can't reach the ledges to go back up the level).

[b]// New Items[/b]

- Blasphem Bombossus: A throwable massive bomb (make sure you leg it after it's thrown!)
- Magic Magnet: Sucks in gold and gems that are somewhat close.
- Spooky Bonepile: Throwable bone projectiles (similar to those the Skeleton throws and who also now have a chance of dropping Bonepiles).
- Banana Pizza: There's a 33% chance your character won't like the taste (this is randomly determined at the start of the run). If you like the taste then it heals 3-5 health, otherwise it hurts 1 health.

[b]// Minor Stuff[/b]

- Bonehaunted: If he picks up hearts then it will now give you a little flamey protector instead of giving you gold.
- You no longer auto-grab ledges if you're holding the attack or bomb buttons.
- Glint Firecrackers: Will now also destroy any enemy projectiles onscreen.
- Divine Trinket: Death blows will now reduce the damage to 1 and count as using a Pure Heart.
- Succulent Fruit: Will now always give you at least +1 Heart and works with Cutty Cutlery. For the Bonehaunted Clan it now randomly gives 1-4 flams.
- Sticky Tape: Can now also be used to repair a Cracked Jewel.
- Bomb Dust: This should now work correctly with the different Clans and Cutty Cutlery.
- Shroom Shack: In the secret room there's a chance of there now being up to 3 Bizarre Mushrooms. They can be used like a regular Mushroom but depending on their type they inflict a screen effect until the invincibility wears off (screen effects are from the Blood Moon Trials).
- Antlered Trader: He will now accept Soulic Jewels and Cracked Jewels which have a high value.
- Guilder's Emporium: Added inventory paging to the Seller's menu when selling stuff and items you can't sell are faded.
- Pots: When standing on a skull ghost pot that you break it no longer instantly hurts you.
- The Restless Adventures game mode now starts off locked until you complete a Lexicanium Hunt.
- Compendium: Locked Clans are now hidden.

[b]// Cabins Reminiscel[/b]

- The way you unlock the game mode has been changed somewhat. Now when you've beaten a Restless Adventure there's then a good chance you'll stumble upon the Unlock Mirror before a stage starts and just requires touching it to unlock the mode. The intro has also been moved here so it's all rather less confusing.
- The save file structure has changed and is now located in "cabin.dat". You shouldn't notice any changes (except the save file being much more organised) but thought I'd mention it in case it mucks something up.
- Guilder: You can now buy multiples of the same item if it would normally be allowed (e.g. orbitals).
- Resetting the game mode will no longer delete the main game mode stats.
- Bug Fix: Giving the Fairy unlock the Flute would wrongly remove a Map from your inventory.
- Bug Fix: The Cursed Memory items would respawn in the Abyss after you've delivered them to the Crypt.
- Bug Fix: If you picked up a Cursed Memory but didn't deliver it and exited the game mode then it wouldn't save which type of Memory it was.

[b]// Misc Bug Fixes[/b]

- Mouse Controls: The mouse aim was affecting both players in Co-Op mode.
- Mouse Controls: When using sword based Clans their facing wasn't updating correctly if you held down the attack button.
- Lexicanium Hunt - Boss: Killing him using the Bonehaunted warp explosion (or similar situations) would cause issues since it creates a new player character after the death sequence has begun.
- Sticky Tape: Could wrongly be used on non-gear items and gear with already full durability.


Enjoy. :]

notes.title: Bonehaunted Mechanius (v8)
notes.content:
Greetings restless....

A new spooky Clan has been added called the Bonehaunted. They are somewhat of a challenge Clan as their brittle bones can typically only get hit twice per stage before it's game over and health pickups won't help, but they regenerate at stage end, carry a whopping flaming sword and have the curious ability to Warp Bomb (creates an explosion where you teleport to). The new Clan has to be unlocked within the Restless Adventure game mode (hint: he's hiding where you might expect a haunted bonepile to be buried).

A new region has also been added called the Sanguine Mechanius. There's a chance of it appearing once you've won a Restless Adventure and it appears quite late on so is a bit of a toughy to deal with until you learn how the various traps operate but stay clear of the bloody blood golems!

In the Cabins Reminiscel game mode two new areas have been added to the Hub and two new characters to meet there. In the normal game modes in between stages you get a gift from your clan, but that's not the case in the Cabin mode any more. Instead you can order supply drops from the Guilder Trader once you've unlocked him, and you can also buy clan relics from him. In the Crypt if you help the poor spook find his lost babies each spirit found will increase your starting health by +1.

And various other niceties... enjoy! :]

[b]// New Stuff[/b]
- 10 new achievements related to the Bonehaunted clan, the Cabins Reminiscel and Soul Survivor game modes.
- Added a new sub-stage called Echoes Solemnity, where you have the option of teleporting to one of a selection of special rooms (Humongous Head, Manky Hole, etc).
- 4 new hats (Scary Screamer, Anointed Flame, Hockey Jason, Potato Face).
- 2 new skin garment/flesh colours (Cursed Purple, Restless Pink).
- 2 new Clashful Cards fighter cards (Imp, Blood Golem).
- Frostal Fields: Added a new enemy, a bigger version of the Hailstone Whirl.
- Blaspheme Librarium: Added a new enemy, a small imp that's a bit of cannon fodder but can alert Liches of your presence. Liches also have a chance of spawning a horde of them when they first see you.
- Guilder's Emporium: Added an extra friendly shopkeeper who will buy your unwanted items and bombs.
- Fairy Fountain: Added unique responses for the following item bestowals: Soiled Diaper, Handy Mirror, Cracked Jewel, Gift Surprise, or any of the clan orbital items.
- Perditions Path: Added a secret Boned Hole.

[b]// New Items[/b]
- Added a new pickup called a Pure Heart. It nullifies the next hit you suffer and gives extra invincibility frames.
- Purity Pendant: Heart pickups become pure hearts.
- Wraithen Talon: Creatures you slay become orbital spectral protectors that hurt enemies.
- Jewelry Box: Contains a random trinket which worth is added to your score, or there's a small chance it may contain a jewel related item.
- Teleport Beamer: Can be used to accurately teleport anywhere onscreen.

[b]// Other Bits & Bobs[/b]
- Aiming has been tweaked for the melee clans. Holding the attack button will retain the same aim direction (just like the ranged attack clans), however, if you let go of the attack button then it will update your aim direction (even when mid-swing, though the swing itself will be the same).
- Co-op: The twin moving offscreen no longer auto-teleports him, instead an arrow shows indicating his position. A player getting hurt no longer plays the hurt animation for both players and won't auto-telport the twin.
- Blood Moon Trials: You can now use the Skip Scene button when dying to quick-restart the trial.
- Blood Moon Trial - Slimes Obstacles Trial: Tweaked the design so it's less confusing that you need to screenwarp.
- Blood Moon Trial - Amaurosis Realm Trial: The b&w now has a pinky overlay so the screen effect no longer melts your eyeballs.
- Cabins Reminiscel: Buying hearts/bombs should work correctly now (previously the different clan effects was mucking this up).
- The Rocketeer: You can now also just hold the Jump button to use it when equipped. Once it's ran out of juice you drop it and it begins to explode.
- Diaper: There's a 10% chance it may nullify an enemy attack, in which case the diaper is "used" (oh no).
- Binocularscope: You are no longer immortal whilst using them.
- Crates: If you have at least 33 bombs then there's a chance a crate containing bombs will instead be booby trapped with live bombs (the more bombs you have the higher the chance).
- Explosions: Their base damage has been reduced a bit. If the player is close to the center of the explosion then the damage suffered is doubled.
- Boo Boner: Their flaming skull attacks no longer destroy your own attacks, but their attack pattern has changed making them a bit more dangerous.
- Level Generation: Special rooms now close off broken paths leading into them (e.g. a Vault Chest room will fully close all paths leading into them).

notes.title: Shrooma Reminisce (v7)
notes.content:
Hey restless venturers, hope the frostal Wintery festivities treated you well. For the first update of the year I thought I'd just do a more general update with most of the game modes getting some bits and bob sprinkles of sprucing up. Enjoy. :]



[b]// Lexicanium Hunt / Restless Adventures[/b]
- Added a new sub-stage called the Shroom Shack where you can pick a box to help you on your way (and has a little secret).
- Added a new sub-room where you can play a card matching game, match cards to win various prizes.
- Slimes Mire: There's now a chance of the area being Cursed. In which case most things are rather more explodey and bubbled, though there's a nice big extra chest to compensate.
- Fallen Sanctum: There's now a chance of the area being Cursed. In which case a purple haze envelops the region, enemies are all replaced with Cursed Boo Gravers, and the haunted statues fire magical projectiles.
- Blaspheme Librarium: If you've beaten the Lexicanium Hunt there's now a chance this region may show up in a Restless Adventure on either stage 6 or 7. The region now uses a 5x7 grid of rooms (instead of the usual 6x6).
- Bug Fix: The Stage Complete room would sometimes have mucked up level theme sprites if you came from a sub-stage, and the circle transition would for a split second be in the middle of the screen instead of the top.

[b]// Cabins Reminiscel[/b]
- Hub World: Added a new area and two unlockable friendly people (so you can now buy bombs/health). To unlock them you have to meet them in the Mirrored Abyss and perform a few tasks. There's 2 new achievements for unlocking them.
- Passive items no longer have any effect in the Hub World (e.g. Newton Sphere, Monocles, Balloon, etc) as this causes too many problems.
- Bug Fix: In the outside Mirror Cave room using the Katanachi clan jumping high when entering the cave would clip through the front sprite.

[b]// Clashful Cards[/b]
- At the start of each game you can now choose to redraw your cards up to two times (just in case you draw a naff set or fancy a gamble).
- Beginning a new game from the escape menu now resets your winning streak.

[b]// Soul Survivor[/b]
- Added usuable items, though they work a little differently. There's a chance of the between Wave item being a usuable. If picked up it's auto-equipped and you cannot have more than one usuable item (picking up a second replaces the first). The usuable item pool includes: Glint Firecrackers, The Rocketeer, Bernard's Watch, Choccy Bar, Exotic Mushroom. Some of these items work slightly differently (e.g. choccies give limited invincibility instead of health).
- Item Pool: Added Newton Sphere.
- Game Over screen: Added the Wave number.
- Status screen: Removed the timer.
- Bug Fix: Using the Pro-HUD the Score was incorrectly aligned.

[b]// Blood Moon Trials[/b]
- Restless Obstacles Trial: Tweaked the design a little so the Minesmither can jump over the last Gravetender and make it easier for him to reach the ladder.

[b]// New Items[/b]
- Abracadabra Wand: Can be used to turn items into other random items, though each time there's a small chance of something unintended happening (either it randomises all your items, turns all items into mushrooms or switches your health and bombs around).

[b]// Misc[/b]
- Batty: Visually tweaked the design to make it a bit bigger so easier to see/hit (added a tail, eyes flash). Added a small effect when it first sees you.
- Buzzy: They now have a vision arc so can be sneaked up on.
- Sticky Tape: Is now instead used to repair usuable items to their full health.
- The small Normal and Gold Chests now have a very small chance of being booby trapped with live bombs.
- Fairy Fountain: You now get something nice if you bestow a Bottled Fairy.
- Shop: If you carry a Soiled Diaper then Shopkeepers will now remark on it and give you their last item if only one remains.
- Reputation Trader: He now has a platform in case you blow up the floor. When trading, the amount of your items it shows has increased, added menu paging if you have more than 18 items, and fixed a few minor bugs when selling items.
- Played around with the Exit Game menu options so submitting your score felt a bit more intuitive. In a Hunt/Adventure the option is to "commit seppuku" which asks to confirm it taking you to the game over screen where you can then choose to restart or quit to title screen.
- Menu head icons now reflect your current clan (e.g. status map screen, escape menus, compendium menus).
- Destroying the Hat Unlock big chests no longer creates Skully Ghosts.

[b]// Misc Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fullscreen: Starting the game in fullscreen then turning it Off would muck up the graphic scaling.
- Vsync: This wasn't being applied at start of game if set to On.
- Going to the Abysm Challenges menu would reset the character customiser in the other game modes.
- If the Minesmither doesn't have a weapon (e.g. during a Trial or Cabin mode) then you couldn't switch directions.
- Runic Hammer: Sometimes the hammer was colliding with an enemy before the normal attack swipe so enemies weren't being killed when they should.
- Diaper: Both the Fresh and Soiled varients were in the item pool (just fresh will do thankies).
- Gnatty: They were not affected by Boot Spikes.
- Taurus: He could still poke you with his trident even when carrying his big bomb.
- Skeleton: Buried skellies will now awaken if the wall below them is destroyed.
- Stairs weren't crumbling if you destroyed the wall next to it.

notes.title: Frostal Moon (v6)
notes.content:
Hey restless. :]

A new game mode has been added called the Blood Moon Trials. It includes a variety of short but difficult challenges, such as defeating a boss or obstacle course without getting hit, making your way through weird realms, or other oddities like pumping your balloon an awful lot. The game mode is unlocked once you beat the Lexicanium Hunt and Restless Adventures, and there's 3 new achievements for beating off those trials.

A new chilly region has also been added called the Frostal Fields. It includes 3 new iced out enemies and a few new hazards to contend with. There's always a random chance of you stumbling into it during a Hunt or Adventure so stay frosty.

Also...

[b]// minor bits & bobs[/b]
- Clashful Cards: 4 new cards: Wordbearer, Hailstone Whirl, Freeze Flake, Abominable Frost
- Single Player Gamepad Input: At game start it now auto-detects a plugged in gamepad if the default input isn't plugged in (so if it was set to xbox but you only have a playstation pad plugged in then it will auto-set it to playstation).
- Button Icons: During the Tutorial the dialogue will attempt to auto-detect your input and set the appropriate button icons (either keyboard, xbox or playstation).
- Soul Survivor: Added Freeze Flake enemy. Using Pro-HUD now shows the current wave.
- Rocketeer Pack: Using the jetpack whilst holding a ledge/ladder will now let go of the ledge/ladder.
- Orbital Shuriken: Now gets a damage boost if you also have Envenomed Blades.
- Crow Caltrops: Now get thrown a bit further if you're aiming upwards.
- Haunted Lantern (Restless Burials): Can now be attacked as it's falling (to explode it before it hits the ground).
- Boo Graver (+purple variant): They now move twice as fast if they're offscreen when stalking you and their firing arc has been widened.
- Skeleton: Must now be fully within the camera view to throw bones (previously he could be below the camera and still throw).
- Pact room: Items have a random durability bonus/penalty between -50% to +50%.
- Fairy Fountain: Added item paging to the bestow item menu.
- Changed the map making code to improve general level performance a smidge.

[b]// bug fixes[/b]
- Mouse Aim: Left click wasn't working in menus.
- Title Screen - Skin Customiser: The player sprite viewer wasn't initially updating the hat/skin when opening.
- Clan Alchemistro: The player sprite's head when looking forward/back wasn't fully affected by skin colour changes.
- Fallen Sanctum: The floating blocks were not appearing on your map.
- Lexicanium Hunt - Boss: The imprisoned child was sometimes changing clan between phases and once freed it wrongly used the player variables for its appearance (e.g. skin, hat, jetpack).
- Abysm Challenges: If you won the game mode then it was sending you to the normal leaderboard instead of the Challenge one.
- Soul Survivor: Using Pro-HUD the score font wasn't correctly set.
- Fairy Fountain: Visually used the wrong area theme if you went to it from the Manky Burrow.
- Shop room: Bomb pickups weren't being affected by clan value modifiers (e.g. Shinobi should get x2 bombs). You could mattock the walls without it angering the shopkeepers.
- Orbital Shuriken and Runic Orbital clan items weren't hurting hanging bats.
- Runic Mineraliser clan item wasn't working in the Perditions Path and Blaspheme Librarium.
- Rocketeer Pack: The dark blue wasn't been affected by skin colour changes.
- In the Adventure's end win plummet scene, the Shinobi and Miner character's head had a thick black outline.
- Status Screen: Item paging always showed down arrow even if you were already on the max page.


Enjoy! And since this will be the last update of the year, Merry Christmas and happy new year! :]

notes.title: Shinobi Minesmithers (v5)
notes.content:
Hey Abysms. :]

Two new clans have been added, the Shinobi and Minesmithers. The Shinobi may seem a little weak at first but are fast and agile and with some nice synergising heirlooms you'll quickly be tossing out multiple envenomed throwing daggers. The Minesmithers are the opposite, slow and sturdy and carry big old mattocks instead of bombs for carving through the regions. They're available to play right away, but in future I'd like to add in some interesting unlock mechanism for them and other new clans. There's also four new achievements associated to them.

There's 7 new items: The Rocketeer, Somarios Staff, Newton Sphere, Bernard's Watch, Voodoo Doll, Notched Mattock, Loyalty Card.

And some other bits & bobs...
- Abysm Challenges: The challenge selection menu now shows what the clan is for that run.
- Clan items have been added to the Itemography which now also has sub-menus for passive/gear/clan. The two previous Itemography achievements have been replaced with three new ones for completing each category. The two Choose Leaderboard menus have been combined into a single menu.
- Void Thorn: Renamed to Infernal Thorn and now also confers explosion immunity.
- Added a visual setting to remove the decorative falling snow.
- In the Slimes Mire region the big explosive red mushrooms have a chance of being a purple variant, in which case they dish out multiple explosions in random directions when hurt.
- Added an extra normal room template to the Fallen Sanctum and Perditions Path regions.
- Redid some of the player character draw code so the black outline should be more consistent.
- Pact room: You can now jump on the altar to reach high items and added a platform so it can be interacted with even if there's no wall below.
- Shop: There's now a 15% chance of it being a speciality shop (Bomb/Gift/Heart) that sells similar item types.
- Soul Survivor: Removed the falling snow.
- During an Adventure/Hunt/Survivor game over it now only takes you to the leaderboard if you score top 12/12/6 online.
- Clashful Cards: Your turn auto-ends after using an action if you have no usable actions left.
- Added a timer to the Pro HUD during the Adventure/Hunt stage end item selection screen since time passes there.


Enjoy. :]

notes.title: Co-op Soul Survivor (v4)
notes.content:
Hey cherubs. :]

Co-op play has been added. You and a local chum can now play any of the game modes together, though you'll have to play nicely as you both share the same resources. You can choose the controls input type for both players in the settings menu.

A new game mode has also been added called Soul Survivor. It's an arena survival mode where you must endure endless gem dropping enemies. The enemies and arena are randomised each wave just to keep you on your toes, and there's 3 achievements to go with the game mode.

Plus some other bits and bobs...

- Added the game's soundtrack to the game folder so should automatically show in your Steam music library.
- New sub-stage: Spookers Reckoning.
- 3 New items: Jellied Eel, Glint Firecrackers, Divine Trinket.
- Added a Gamepad Input setting so you can set the default gamepad input for single player mode.


[b]Enjoy. :][/b]

notes.title: Lexicanium Hunt (v3)
notes.content:
Hey restless abysms. :]

A new game mode has been added called the Lexicanium Hunt. It includes a new boss and region called the Blaspheme Librarium which is home to a few new enemies/traps. The Hunt is just the 4 stages long compared to the Adventures 8 so it's intended as more of a tea-break jaunt if you don't quite fancy a full on score run Adventure. The Daily Abysm Challenge will now also use the Hunt mode.

Some other stuff too...

- 7 new items (Haunted Balloon, Voidic Thorn, Choccy Bar, Witchery Potion, Pixie Compass, Sticky Tape, Springy Sandals).
- Improved performance by about 25%.
- 5 new achievements (Lexicanium Hunt, Lexicanium Filthy Stinkin Rich, Lexicanium Gotta Go Fast, Spiritful Clan Alchemistro, Spiritful Clan Katanachi).
- Added stats for the Abysm Challenges to the Grimoire Compendium.
- Added a Reset Aim setting which resets your aiming to the horizontal if no direction is pressed.
- Added a Quiet Hero setting which reduces the volume of player sounds (e.g. jumping, shooting).
- Rejigged the Escape Menu so you can end the game to submit your current score and makes accidentally restarting your game harder.
- 1 new Clashful Cards card (Lichema) (wow!)
- Enrealmed Cloak: If you're already cloaked then moving will no longer reveal you (note actions like jumping still will).
- You can now also sell Jewels to the Shoppie by standing in front to interact with him.
- Katanachi can now have up to 4 mecha balls!
- Minor non-gameplay bits & bobs.

[b]Enjoy! :][/b]

notes.title: Gubbins Update (v2)
notes.content:
Hey abysms. :]

Just want to give a big thanks to the Abysm Community for your kind words and feedback since the release of Spirits Abyss. There's been a fair amount of suggestions to improve controls, quality-of-life, balance, etc, so I just wanted to spend a bit of time working on the various reported issues.

[i]Here be changes...[/i]


[b]/// General[/b]
- Added a Skip Scene button to the various Game Over, End Boss and Won Game scenes. Press then hold the confirm button (there's an indicator in the bottom right).
- Status Screen: Now shows a few more items and can be fully page scrolled if you have lots of items.
- Settings - Added an Epilepsy Mode option which greatly reduces strobes, flashes, and screenshakes.
- Settings - Added an Aim Indicator option which draws a small arrow in the direction you're aiming.
- Settings - Added an Auto Ledge Grab option which toggles whether you need to hold up to ledge grab (defaulted to "auto").
- Settings - Added a Reverse Ledge Jump option which toggles whether you need to be holding into or away from the wall to perform a wall-jump when also ledge-grabbed (defaulted to "away").
- Settings - Added options to change what action the Menu Confirm and Menu Back buttons are assigned to.
- Settings - Added description texts to clear up a bit what the various options do.
- Compendium: Added game mode stats for Clashful Cards and Cabins Reminiscel.
- Clashful Cards: Added a tutorial and the option to play against a local human.
- At the game mode selection screen the game mode boxes and clan boxes now have up to three gems reflecting progression within that game mode (e.g. achievements).
- Cabins Reminiscel: You can now choose to wipe this game mode's save data by talking to the creepy statue in the mirror cave. Also added an intro scene after you've unlocked it that explains you're now in the this mode and the differences from the Restless Adventures mode.
- Look Up/Down: Fixed a bug where the look counter wasn't being reset, which would result in the player looking up/down without first holding the button by itself for a full second.
- Switched the default buttons for Jump and Shoot around (e.g. on an xbox pad pressing A to jump and X to attack seems to be the norm).

[b]/// Balance - changes to make initial learning smoother[/b]
- Player invincibility time increased by +25% overall except for the blue area region which is increased by +37%.
- Bats: Now slightly slower and behave much less erratically if they can't see you.
- Running Ghost: Now inflicts 2 damage when touched instead of 3.
- Skull Ghost: Now inflicts 1 damage when touched instead of 2 (this only applies in the blue area region).

[b]/// Balance - changes to reduce end-game ballooning[/b]
- The number of crates is decreased in later stage regions (purple:-25%, red:-50%), where as previously it was the same all over. Chance of them having bomb boxes is reduced.
- Treasure Chests in general are now mainly about gold/gems rather than stuffing you with items.
- Stage Completion Scene: Much less chance of bomb boxes.
- Bomb Boxes now give 8 bombs instead of 10.
- Shop: Item costs are increased based on the stage region (green:x2, purple:x3, red:x4). Has less chance of selling bombs.
- Some late game enemies are now bomb resistant (Boo Knight, Taurus, Skullion, Undying Boss) which greatly reduces the effectiveness of bombs (though they still do more damage than regular attacks).
- Undying Boss: Bomb damage reduces his attack timer so he attacks quicker if you bomb him (this already applied to regular damage but there was a bug preventing this happening with bomb damage). The speed of the skulls he spawns is reduced (big ones were pretty nasty).
- Fairy Fountain: If offered a Diamond there's a chance you may get 1 or 2 hearts instead of the full 3.


[b]Enjoy. :][/b]
